Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class CalendarModel

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.CalendarModel
public final class CalendarModel extends Object
The pure java.time model behind the 2D taskbar clock's calendar popup: how a month lays out as an ISO Monday-first grid, which cell is today, and how a month is titled.

Every method is deterministic given an injected Clock, so the grid layout — including leap-year Februaries and 31-day months starting on each weekday — is unit-testable headless. CalendarPopup is the thin Swing view that renders this model on the 2D desktop; the lg3d-widgets built-in CalendarCard is a second, Java 3D-free view of the same model on the 3D desktop, so the month layout is written exactly once.
